title: The Guide Replays an Old Story Instead of Going Silent | vitalii.no
description:
On roads driven almost every day, eventually every nearby place has already been mentioned — and when nothing new is left to flash, a driving guide app just went silent, turning minutes of a familiar commute into dead air.

DriveService.java now adds a replay mechanism: once a place has been quiet for long enough, it becomes eligible to be replayed from an earlier drive instead of leaving the guide silent, while a genuinely new place along the route always takes priority over a repeat. A second fix capped how far from a town's center a multi-part "road episode" is allowed to start.

Replays only trigger after 16 hours of silence on a given place. A separate bug that let an area-wide episode start playing up to 2.5 kilometers before the actual town is now fixed too — it waits until the car is almost there.
